import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()

# Action helper: target the arm joints and set both fingers to one aperture.
def action(q, fingers=0.04):
    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
    return np.r_[q, fingers, fingers]

"""Own visual/proprioceptive controller for VLABench select_book_spatial instance i00.
All robot interaction is through the eai-standard rcb_client service.
"""
import sys, json, time
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from rcb_client import Robot

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
LAYOUT = spec['proprio_layout']
JOINT_LIMITS = np.asarray(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['panda_joint_limits_rad'], float)

def unpack(meta):
    a = np.asarray(meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    d = dict(zip(LAYOUT, a))
    q = np.array([d[f'joint{i}_pos'] for i in range(1, 8)])
    p = np.array([d[f'tcp_{k}'] for k in ['x','y','z']])
    quat = np.array([d[f'tcp_q{c}'] for c in ['w','x','y','z']])
    R = Rotation.from_quat([quat[1],quat[2],quat[3],quat[0]]).as_matrix()
    fingers = np.array([d['finger1_pos'], d['finger2_pos']])
    cmd = np.array([d[f'cmd_joint{i}'] for i in range(1,8)])
    return q,p,R,fingers,cmd

def send(q, fingers=0.04, seconds=1.0, note='controller move'):
    q = np.clip(np.asarray(q, float), JOINT_LIMITS[:,0]+0.01, JOINT_LIMITS[:,1]-0.01)
    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / spec['control_dt'])))
    before = r.status()
    now = np.asarray(before.get('proprio', {}).get('now', []), float)
    # The status endpoint may omit proprio, so start each short ramp from the last known actuator target.
    # Position targets are streamed densely to keep the motion slow and predictable.
    if len(now):
        q0 = np.array([now[LAYOUT.index(f'joint{i}_pos')] for i in range(1,8)])
    else:
        q0 = LAST_Q.copy()
    f0 = float(LAST_F)
    rows=[]
    for j in range(1,n+1):
        frac=j/n
        qj=q0+(q-q0)*frac
        fj=f0+(float(fingers)-f0)*frac
        rows.append(np.r_[qj,fj,fj])
    res=r.submit('joint_position', np.asarray(rows), dt=spec['control_dt'], interpolate='linear',
                 cameras=['wrist'], video='none', note=note)
    global LAST_Q,LAST_F
    LAST_Q,LAST_F=q.copy(),float(fingers)
    return res

def current():
    st=r.status()
    # status has no pose in this service version; a free wrist observation includes current proprio.
    res=r.get_obs(cameras=['wrist'], video='none')
    q,p,R,f,cmd=unpack(res.meta)
    return q,p,R,f,cmd,res

def pose_error(p,R,pd,Rd):
    dp=np.asarray(pd)-p
    dr=Rotation.from_matrix(Rd @ R.T).as_rotvec()
    return np.r_[dp,dr]

def jacobian(q0,p0,R0,fingers,eps=0.05):
    J=np.zeros((6,7))
    for j in range(7):
        qcur,pcur,Rcur,_,_,_=current()
        # Rebase on actual state for each probe to avoid accumulating servo tracking error.
        qbase=qcur.copy(); pbase=pcur.copy(); Rbase=Rcur.copy()
        qp=qbase.copy(); qp[j]=np.clip(qp[j]+eps, JOINT_LIMITS[j,0]+0.02, JOINT_LIMITS[j,1]-0.02)
        res=send(qp,fingers=fingers,seconds=0.6,note=f'Jacobian probe joint {j+1}')
        qa,pa,Ra,_,_,_=unpack(res.meta)
        dq=qa[j]-qbase[j]
        if abs(dq)<0.012:
            # Allow more servo time if the tiny probe has not settled.
            res=send(qp,fingers=fingers,seconds=0.5,note=f'Jacobian probe settle joint {j+1}')
            qa,pa,Ra,_,_,_=unpack(res.meta); dq=qa[j]-qbase[j]
        if abs(dq)<0.006:
            raise RuntimeError(f'joint {j+1} probe did not move enough: {dq}')
        J[:3,j]=(pa-pbase)/dq
        J[3:,j]=Rotation.from_matrix(Ra @ Rbase.T).as_rotvec()/dq
        send(qbase,fingers=fingers,seconds=0.6,note=f'restore after probe joint {j+1}')
    return J

def move_cartesian(pd, Rd=None, fingers=0.04, max_iter=12, label='Cartesian move'):
    q,p,R,f,cmd,res=current()
    if Rd is None: Rd=R.copy()
    for it in range(max_iter):
        e=pose_error(p,R,pd,Rd)
        pos_err=np.linalg.norm(e[:3]); rot_err=np.linalg.norm(e[3:])
        print(json.dumps({'stage':label,'iteration':it,'tcp':p.tolist(),'position_error_m':float(pos_err),'orientation_error_rad':float(rot_err),'joints':q.tolist(),'control_steps':r.status()['control_steps']}),flush=True)
        if pos_err<0.012 and rot_err<0.12:
            return q,p,R
        J=jacobian(q,p,R,fingers)
        # Scale orientation to a 15 cm characteristic lever arm, then apply damped least squares.
        W=np.diag([1.,1.,1.,0.15,0.15,0.15])
        A=W@J; b=W@e
        damp=0.025
        dq=A.T@np.linalg.solve(A@A.T+damp*damp*np.eye(6),b)
        norm=np.linalg.norm(dq)
        if norm>0.22: dq*=0.22/norm
        qnext=np.clip(q+dq,JOINT_LIMITS[:,0]+0.02,JOINT_LIMITS[:,1]-0.02)
        # Scale back if joint bounds shortened the Cartesian correction excessively.
        send(qnext,fingers=fingers,seconds=1.0,note=f'{label} step {it+1}')
        q,p,R,f,cmd,res=current()
    print(json.dumps({'stage':label,'warning':'iteration limit','tcp':p.tolist(),'target':np.asarray(pd).tolist()}),flush=True)
    return q,p,R

# initialize targets from live proprio, then choose the active phase below.
q0,p0,R0,f0,cmd0,res0=current()
LAST_Q=q0.copy(); LAST_F=float(np.mean(f0))
print(json.dumps({'initial_tcp':p0.tolist(),'initial_joints':q0.tolist(),'fingers':f0.tolist(),'status':r.status()}),flush=True)

phase=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'observe'
if phase=='observe':
    cams=r.get_obs(cameras=['forward','left','right','wrist'],include_depth=True,video='none')
    for name,img in cams.last.items():
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(img).save(f'/app/output/current_{name}.png')
    for name,dep in cams.depth.items(): np.save(f'/app/output/current_{name}_depth.npy',dep)
    print(json.dumps(cams.meta),flush=True)
elif phase=='stage':
    # Staging pose above the top shelf, in front of the target. Target is estimated only from camera depth.
    q,p,R=move_cartesian([0.12,0.10,1.36], R0, fingers=0.04, label='top-shelf staging')
    res=r.get_obs(cameras=['forward','wrist'],include_depth=True,video='none')
    from PIL import Image
    for name,img in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(f'/app/output/stage_{name}.png')
    for name,dep in res.depth.items(): np.save(f'/app/output/stage_{name}_depth.npy',dep)
    print(json.dumps({'stage':'staged','tcp':p.tolist(),'joints':q.tolist(),'meta':res.meta}),flush=True)
elif phase=='advance':
    # Approach position immediately in front of the target book; keep fingertips above the book top.
    q,p,R=move_cartesian([0.12,0.245,1.36], R0, fingers=0.04, label='approach target book')
    res=r.get_obs(cameras=['forward','wrist'],include_depth=True,video='none')
    from PIL import Image
    for name,img in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(f'/app/output/approach_{name}.png')
    for name,dep in res.depth.items(): np.save(f'/app/output/approach_{name}_depth.npy',dep)
    print(json.dumps({'stage':'approached','tcp':p.tolist(),'joints':q.tolist(),'meta':res.meta}),flush=True)
else:
    raise ValueError(f'unknown phase {phase}')

def jacobian_fixed(fingers=0.04,eps=0.04):
    q_anchor,p_anchor,R_anchor,_,_,_=current()

        send(qp,fingers=fingers,seconds=0.8,hold_seconds=0.5,note=f'fixed-base probe joint {j+1}')

        if abs(dq)<0.01:
            qm=q_anchor.copy(); qm[j]=np.clip(qm[j]-eps,JOINT_LIMITS[j,0]+0.02,JOINT_LIMITS[j,1]-0.02)
            send(qm,fingers=fingers,seconds=0.8,hold_seconds=0.5,note=f'fixed-base reverse probe joint {j+1}')
            qa,pa,Ra,_,_=unpack(r.get_obs(cameras=['wrist'],video='none').meta)
            dq=qa[j]-q_anchor[j]
        if abs(dq)>=0.006:
            J[:3,j]=(pa-p_anchor)/dq
            J[3:,j]=Rotation.from_matrix(Ra @ R_anchor.T).as_rotvec()/dq
        else:
            print(json.dumps({'warning':'fixed-base unresponsive joint','joint':j+1,'delta':float(dq)}),flush=True)
        send(q_anchor,fingers=fingers,seconds=0.8,hold_seconds=0.5,note=f'fixed-base restore joint {j+1}')
    return J

def move_cartesian_fast(pd,Rd,fingers=0.04,max_iter=20,label='fast Cartesian move'):
    J=None; last_pos=None; force_refresh=True
    for it in range(max_iter):
